_manifest_note: Single source of truth for court-engine role configuration (Q455). models.<role> is the per-role model; models.<role>_provider is the Kilo CLI provider; model_aliases maps human/display model names to qualified provider/model IDs; suite.command is the canonical unified integration suite invocation used by git_ops suite detection (heuristics are fallback only); harness.command is the castle's read-only production verification harness (e.g. pb-app's ROQ scripts/db/roq.py) used by charter/MoC protocols for data-mutation dry-run gates. Docs (.court/README.md, AGENTS.md, .court/GLOSSARY.md) reference this file; they do not restate values. Each castle binds suite.command and harness.command to its own tooling.
